docs.title: Servo Motor Control
docs.text:
This example demonstrates how to control a servo motor using Arduino.

```cpp

docs.title:
include // Include the Servo library

Servo myServo; // Create a Servo object named "myServo"

void setup() { myServo.attach(9); // Attach the servo to pin 9 }

void loop() { myServo.write(0); // Rotate servo to 0 degrees delay(1000); // Wait 1 second

myServo.write(90); // Rotate servo to 90 degrees (middle) delay(1000); // Wait 1 second

myServo.write(180); // Rotate servo to 180 degrees (maximum) delay(1000); // Wait 1 second

myServo.write(90); // Return to 90 degrees delay(1000); // Wait 1 second before repeating }
